title: Sponsor the Summit!
description: Archived invitation to sponsor the May 2015 OpenStack Summit in Vancouver, linking to the historical sponsorship instructions.
body:
If you're interested in sponsoring the May 2015 OpenStack Summit please fully read the Become A Sponsor page and then complete both electronic contracts.

Contact summit@openstack.org if you have any questions.
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
